tokens.name: wordmark-ink

tokens.name: wordmark-accent
tokens.usage: Map lettering: forest green on white, original gold on dark.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: White page ground in light mode; near-black in dark mode.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text across the base surfaces.

tokens.name: body-text
tokens.usage: Paragraph copy across the base surfaces.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary labels, captions and supporting metadata.

tokens.name: muted-foreground-elevated
tokens.usage: Secondary labels on raised panels and inputs.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: White panels in light mode. Use a hairline or surface-quiet to define groups.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised panels, hover fills and inputs inside a surface.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card fill (same as surface); pair with gradient-metal for the brushed 3D card.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, select dropdowns, the support-chat panel.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: EzyMap green: primary action and links. Use semantic tokens for market and feed states.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-glow
tokens.usage: Deep EzyMap green: the dark end of gradient-green and button bevels; large dark-green fills. Never as text on dark grounds (3.6:1); foreground on it reads 4.9:1.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Faint green wash behind chips, selected rows and active tabs.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Legacy gold accent for brand artwork and premium details; not for focus or actions.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Dark end of gradient-gold; pressed gold.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Faint gold wash behind premium badges and highlighted rows.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary fills (tabs, segmented controls).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Muted fills: skeletons, disabled backgrounds.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors, never price direction. Always include a descriptive label.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Subtle decorative hairline; use control-border for interactive boundaries.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Hairline on hover.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Visible input boundary. Use ring for keyboard focus.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, offset for separation from the control.

tokens.name: market-up
tokens.usage: Price up, winning trade, long.

tokens.name: market-down
tokens.usage: Price down, losing trade, or short. Pair gold with a sign, arrow, or text.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral status such as breakeven or cancelled. Pair with a label.

tokens.name: status-stop
tokens.usage: Stop-loss and high risk. Pair with a visible label.

tokens.name: surface-quiet
tokens.usage: Soft grouping surface for filter bars, demos and inset details.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Visible boundaries on interactive controls.

tokens.name: selected-bg
tokens.usage: Selection fill. Pair with a check, label, or active indicator.

tokens.name: feed-live
tokens.usage: Live feed with a text label.

tokens.name: feed-delayed
tokens.usage: Delayed feed with text and last-known time.

tokens.name: feed-offline
tokens.usage: Unavailable feed with text and last-known time if available.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Perspective grid floors and HUD grids behind hero objects. Decorative only, never under body text.

tokens.name: frame-line
tokens.usage: Decorative frame line in hero and 3D compositions.

tokens.name: holo-edge
tokens.usage: Border of the holo card, the one panel per view that holds the key action or checklist.

fonts.name: Clash Display
fonts.usage: Display headings. Use the original artwork for logo lockups.

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.usage: Prices, levels, timestamps and code. Use tabular figures for comparisons.

fonts.name: Instrument Serif
fonts.usage: Occasional editorial accents and pull quotes.

styles.usage: Responsive H1 from 32px to 60px at a 16px root.

styles.name: section-title

styles.name: display-accent
styles.usage: Editorial serif moment inside a display headline. One italic accent per view.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a section title.

styles.name: body

styles.name: body-sm

spacing.note: Tailwind v4 scale: 1 step = 0.25rem (4px). Steps listed are the ones the site uses most.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Flag dot gap, tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and chips; button sm vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Button md vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; button lg vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; button sm horizontal padding; stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact); button md horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button lg horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section header to content.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Min height, button sm.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Min height, button md (touch target).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Min height, button lg.

radius.note: Derived from --radius: 0.5rem (calc values resolved at 16px root).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Book covers, small tags. calc(var(--radius) - 4px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, the neon CTA. calc(var(--radius) - 2px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons sm/md, small cards. = --radius.

tokens.name: radius-button-lg
tokens.usage: Button lg. Matches the design-system-v2 large radius.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards. calc(var(--radius) + 4px).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels, modals. calc(var(--radius) + 8px).

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Large showcase panels. calc(var(--radius) + 12px).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: SignalFlag, HeroPill, avatars.

shadow.note: Use flat surfaces for routine data. Apply neutral depth to floating layers and reserve green-edged depth for hero objects.

tokens.name: shadow-gold
tokens.usage: Minimal lift under gold elements.

tokens.name: shadow-green
tokens.usage: Minimal lift under green elements.

tokens.name: shadow-elevated
tokens.usage: Three-layer depth for floating panels and modals.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: The glass-card: top-edge highlight, bottom bevel, deep drop. Use with gradient-metal.

tokens.name: shadow-button-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button bevel and green halo.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: card-lift hover: card rises 3px and picks up a green underglow.

tokens.name: shadow-book
tokens.usage: 3D ebook cover drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-holo
tokens.usage: Holo card: green edge glow plus deep drop. One per view.

gradient.note: Use the theme-aware finishes for staged objects and decorative fills. Use solid surface tokens for reading and controls.

tokens.name: gradient-hero
tokens.usage: Hero section ground.

tokens.name: gradient-metal
tokens.usage: Brushed-metal card fill (glass-card, gradient-card).

tokens.name: gradient-gold
tokens.usage: Solid gold fills: premium badges, the gold bar.

tokens.name: gradient-green
tokens.usage: Solid green fills: progress, the green bar.

tokens.name: gradient-brand
tokens.usage: Green-to-gold: CTA band, gradient-tick, brand text. Once per page at most.

tokens.name: gradient-hero-pill
tokens.usage: HeroPill fill.

tokens.name: gradient-holo-glow
tokens.usage: Soft green light behind the hero object (gem, chart panel, tier podium). One per surface.

motion.note: Durations and easings for the animated layer. Animate transform and opacity only; every animation needs a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus and color transitions on controls.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Card lift, panel reveals.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Logo float, page-level transitions.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default easing for UI transitions.

tokens.name: ease-emphasized
tokens.usage: Entrances that should feel deliberate (modals, hero reveals).

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Exits run faster than entrances.

tokens.name: duration-xl
tokens.usage: Ambient loops, logo orbits and slow reveals.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Playful overshoot for badges, icon pops and micro-celebrations. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: ease-spring-snappy
tokens.usage: Quick spring with a firm overshoot — UI that should feel alive but not bouncy (badges, toggles, popovers). Cubic-bezier approximation of a stiff spring (~stiffness 400 / damping 25 in Motion terms).

tokens.name: ease-spring-gentle
tokens.usage: Soft spring with a subtle overshoot — entrances and reveals that settle calmly (~stiffness 120 / damping 20 in Motion terms).

breakpoint.note: Mobile-first layout widths. Values are min-widths.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones landscape, small tablets.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets portrait.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Tablets landscape, small laptops. Two-column grids start here.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktops. The showcase container caps near this width.
